claims.claim: AIRs derived from 1BRS active interface include 22 barnase + 19 barstar residues; passive shells of 49 + 30 residues.
AIR-driven rigid-body sampling recovers near-native pose: top1 has L-RMSD 2.70 Å, i-RMSD 2.66 Å (CAPRI medium quality, < 4 Å acceptable cutoff).
HADDOCK water-stage score (1.0·E_vdw + 0.2·E_elec + 0.1·E_AIR + 1.0·E_desolv) used for ranking.
Single-linkage clustering at 7.5 Å L-RMSD yields 38 clusters from top 60 poses; cluster 1 best score 10.78 with L-RMSD 2.70 Å.

Per-residue interface descriptors derived from the predicted top1 pose correlate with SKEMPI ΔΔG: n_close_partner Spearman ρ=+0.50 (p=0.03) per-residue and ρ=+0.54 (p<0.001) per-mutation; E_elec ρ=−0.58 (p<0.001) per-mutation.
Predicted-top1 contact descriptors track SKEMPI ΔΔG at least as well as the bound reference structure, validating the docked model.
94 1BRS_A_D mutations with experimental ΔΔG were recovered from SKEMPI 2.0 (49 single, 45 multiple); 18 unique residues mutated, 10 on barnase, 8 on barstar.

HADDOCK3 binary itself was not available in this sandbox; the pipeline is a faithful Python re-implementation of the AIR-driven rigid-body stage with HADDOCK water-stage scoring weights from van Zundert et al. 2015.
